name: FRDM-MCXA153
description: $15 FRDM board for the 96 MHz Cortex-M33 MCX A153 with an MCU-Link CMSIS-DAP debugger, USB-C, and Arduino, FRDM, Pmod and mikroBUS headers.
notes: Two USB-C ports: one for the MCU-Link debug probe, one for the MCU's full-speed USB device port. Includes an I3C/I2C temperature sensor and a USB-C cable.
128 KB flash / 32 KB RAM (8 KB with ECC). The kit supports MCXA13x/14x/15x parts. RGB LED, board size and GPIO count are approximate.
